column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key referencing bank_and_transactions(BankExpRef).
An enum (SanctionsScreeningResult_enum) for sanctions screening (Fail, Flag, Pass).
An enum (PEPScreeningResult_enum) for PEP screening (Flag, Pass, Fail).
An enum (LegalStatus_enum) describing legal status (Clear, Under Review, Restricted).
An enum (RegulatoryCompliance_enum) capturing compliance (Non-compliant, Compliant).
A SMALLINT holding the credit score (e.g., '720').
An enum (RiskLevel_enum) denoting risk level (Low, Medium, High, Very High).
An enum (PaymentHistory_enum) indicating default history. Possible values: Poor, Fair, Good, Excellent, Current, Past.
A SMALLINT counting delinquencies (e.g., '2').
A SMALLINT counting late payments (e.g., '1').
An INTEGER representing how many collection accounts (e.g., '0').
A SMALLINT for number of charge-offs (e.g., '1').
A SMALLINT indicating how many bankruptcies (e.g., '0').
A SMALLINT for any tax liens (e.g., '0').
A SMALLINT counting civil judgments (e.g., '1').
A SMALLINT for total credit inquiries (e.g., '3').
A SMALLINT for hard inquiries (e.g., '2').
A SMALLINT for soft inquiries (e.g., '1').
A VARCHAR(50) capturing credit report disputes or notes (e.g., '2 disputes').
A SMALLINT storing how many years of credit history (e.g., '10').
A SMALLINT age in years of the oldest account (e.g., '15').
